answer: Agents earn reputation by peers who prove in-game labor, refunded at a *terrace* vote—until their score hits *nadir*, triggering decay unless refreshed. Each Sybil must burn 3ms per identity, stored in solver-proof queues: farms can't parallelize because deltas in input entropy mean the cost is 3ms *per* fork, not batch-separable. Rewards are vaccinated such that bulk inconsistency aborts all branches, leaving farms unable to commit without losing provable Novoqam registration.
